title: GrowthBook case studies (v2)
description: A pale lavender band framed by hairline rails: a big heading with a gradient rail accent, an outline button on the right, and a row of deep ink-violet story cards (wordmark, one-line story, a big result, a mono read link) that slides sideways as you scroll down the page. Each wordmark sharpens from a blur as it enters.
notes: CSS only: the sideways slide follows the page scroll; without scroll timelines or with reduced motion the row is a plain swipe row
the cards always use the theme's dark colours (dark class)
